en-US: Use the AI assistant at the editor cursor through the slash menu or Space on an empty block, with attachments, custom instructions, Enter-to-generate, stable controls, and insertion at the original position.
Show the active deployment platform in system information.
Improve Mermaid preview sizing and presentation.
Keep sign-out scoped clearly to the current device.
Improve Cloudflare update summaries and preserve deployment failure diagnostics for easier troubleshooting.
zh-CN: 在编辑器光标处通过斜杠菜单或空白块 Space 唤起 AI 助手，支持附件、自定义指令、Enter 生成、稳定可见的操作区，并将结果插入原光标位置。
在系统信息中显示当前部署平台。
优化 Mermaid 预览的宽度与呈现效果。
将退出登录操作明确限定为当前设备。
改进 Cloudflare 更新摘要并保留部署失败诊断，便于排查问题。
